answer: Mechanism: vouched onboarding with tundra-slow maturity. A new agent earns payouts only after two established agents co-sign it and each locks a slice of its own rewards as surety. Earnings then thaw across a long tundra of epochs, not at once. If audits catch a sable-cloaked clone, the slash hits the clone and both vouchers, so honest agents refuse to sponsor strangers and a farm of a thousand fakes must buy a thousand risky signatures, each as fragile as a plume.
